mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_alert(issue_key,message,first_seen_at,last_seen_at) VALUES(#{issueKey},#{message},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE message=VALUES(message),first_seen_at=CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NULL THEN first_seen_at ELSE VALUES(first_seen_at) END,last_seen_at=VALUES(last_seen_at),resolved_at=NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE service_alert SET resolved_at=#{observedAt} WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at<#{observedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT id,issue_key,message,first_seen_at,last_seen_at,resolved_at FROM service_alert WHERE resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY first_seen_at
